# Software Requirements Specification: Pomodoro Timer Minute Focus Minute Break Cycles Animated Circular Progress Bar Customizable Sound Alerts Daily Task Completion Checklist
**Project Prompt:** Build a Pomodoro timer application with 25-minute focus and 5-minute break cycles, animated circular progress bar, customizable sound alerts, and a daily task completion checklist.
**Target Architecture:** Modern Full-Stack Web Application (React + TypeScript / FastAPI / REST API / SQLite)

---

### 1. Executive Summary & Core Objective
Develop a production-ready, fully interactive **Pomodoro Timer Minute Focus Minute Break Cycles Animated Circular Progress Bar Customizable Sound Alerts Daily Task Completion Checklist** web platform. The system is designed to provide seamless user interaction, robust business logic processing, structured state management, and real-time feedback tailored specifically to solve: "Build a Pomodoro timer application with 25-minute focus and 5-minute break cycles, animated circular progress bar, customizable sound alerts, and a daily task completion checklist.".

---

### 2. Target Users & Key Personas
- **Primary Operator / Power User:** Needs intuitive controls, rapid data entry, filterable management views, and instant operational metrics.
- **General End User / Consumer:** Expects responsive navigation, low-friction workflows, accessible interfaces, and clear status indicators.
- **System Administrator:** Oversees configuration settings, user roles, audit trails, and platform health telemetry.

---

### 3. Core Functional Requirements & Feature Modules

#### Module A: Interactive User Dashboard & Core Workflow
- Dedicated primary view providing immediate overview metrics, activity summaries, and status badges.
- Intuitive action toolbar enabling users to initiate primary tasks with validated inputs.

#### Module B: Data Management & Operational Workflows
- Comprehensive CRUD lifecycle management tailored to Pomodoro Timer Minute Focus Minute Break Cycles Animated Circular Progress Bar Customizable Sound Alerts Daily Task Completion Checklist entities.
- Advanced search, multi-field filtering, sorting, and pagination for high data density views.

#### Module C: Analytics, Telemetry & Real-Time Feedback
- Live status indicators, visual progress bars, and statistical cards summarizing system state.
- Toast notifications and inline alerts providing immediate feedback on operational success or errors.

#### Module D: Configuration & Customization Options
- User preferences, theme switching (Dark/Light mode), and configurable operational parameters.

---

### 4. Technical Architecture & Component Hierarchy

#### Frontend (React + TypeScript)
- `App.tsx`: Central state container, route management, and global layout shell.
- `MainDashboard.tsx`: High-level operational overview, metric cards, and primary action controls.
- `DetailInspector.tsx`: In-depth entity inspector with interactive tabs and editing controls.
- `ActionBar.tsx`: Filter, search, and action dispatch controls.

#### Backend (FastAPI + Async Python)
- `main.py`: Application entrypoint, CORS configuration, and route registrations.
- `api/routes.py`: RESTful endpoints servicing core domain entities and operations.
- `schemas/models.py`: Strongly-typed Pydantic schemas validating input payloads and responses.

---

### 5. Data Entities & Schema Models
- **CoreDomainEntity:** `id (UUID/str)`, `title (str)`, `category (str)`, `status (str)`, `metadata (Dict)`, `created_at (datetime)`.
- **OperationPayload:** Request validation schemas with type enforcement and boundary constraints.
- **SystemHealth:** Diagnostics probe reporting operational status, uptime, and database connectivity.

---

### 6. REST API Endpoints & Interfaces
- `GET /api/v1/items`: Query all domain items with optional status and search filters.
- `POST /api/v1/items`: Create and validate a new entity.
- `GET /api/v1/items/{id}`: Fetch detailed item record with sub-entity relations.
- `PUT /api/v1/items/{id}`: Update entity properties with concurrency verification.
- `DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}`: Safely remove or soft-delete entity records.

---

### 7. Edge Cases, Security & Resilience
- **Input Sanitization & Validation:** Strict schema boundaries preventing malformed or dangerous payloads.
- **Error Handling & Graceful Degradation:** Informative user-facing error toasts without leaking internal stack traces.
- **Responsive Layout:** Adaptive CSS Grid and Flexbox ensuring full usability across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

---

### 8. Acceptance Criteria & Definition of Done
1. Complete end-to-end user flow functions reliably from initial input to persistent state.
2. Interactive dashboard provides instant visual feedback upon state mutations.
3. Clean, modern dark-themed user interface matching Coalesce enterprise design standards.
4. Comprehensive test suite validates core business logic, schema boundaries, and API endpoints.
